messages:
maya: Short postmortem follow-up: recurring mid-stream cutoffs (clients see partial tokens then silence). We need clear owners for server heartbeat/resume, client retry/resume, observability, and runbook. Keep it tactical.

trent: I'll own server heartbeat + resume token lifecycle. Plan: send 10s keepalive frames, attach `resume_token` on final chunk, and hold tokens for 75s. Spike + tests by Wed.

viv: I'll take client retry/resume behavior. Proposal: try resume if token present within 60s, jittered exponential backoff (base 300ms, max 3 retries). Add `X-Client-Stream-Stage` headers during canary. PR by Fri.

maya: Observability needs?

oncall-sre: I'll update runbook and alerts. Metrics to add: `stream_partial_count`, `stream_last_gap_ms` (histogram), `resume_attempts_total`, `resume_success_total`. Pager rule: page if partial_rate >0.2% for 10m OR resume_fail_rate >10% for 15m. Runbook ETA 48h.

trent: Implementation note: don't close socket until flush ack or resume token is emitted. Log line example: `INFO stream_close stream_id=%s last_gap_ms=%d resume_token=%s`. Canary region: staging -> us-west-2.

viv: Client rollout plan: feature-flag 5% -> 30% -> 100% with debug headers. Will add integration tests that simulate metadata-only frames and abrupt TCP resets.

maya: I'll run a 10m daily sync for the next 7 business days to track PRs, dashboards, and canary results.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-6001: "stream-resume-heartbeat-epic". Assignees: trent, viv, oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: Acceptance criteria: canary shows partial_response_rate <0.03% and resume_success_rate >=98% for 48h. Also confirm resume tokens present in >99% of candidate responses.

trent: Spike details: resume token entropy 128 bits, TTL 75s, metric `resume_token_age_ms`. Will include a feature-flag for keepalive emission.

viv: Adding client header `X-Trace-Stream` for correlation. Also include `X-Stream-Resume-Attempt` telemetry.

maya: Good. Post links here when PRs and dashboards are ready, and ping if blocked. :white_check_mark:
